text:
Alex: Heads-up — in us-west3 we saw a cluster of GPU hosts start evicting at ~22:00 UTC after the BMC rollout.
Morgan: How many nodes and which pool?
Alex: 6 nodes in pool-gpu-highmem-3. Evictions were rapid; scheduler reported OOM but logs show OOB console heartbeat loss first.
infra-bot: [ALERT] oob-heartbeat-loss detected: hostset=pool-gpu-highmem-3 count=6 start=2024-11-05T22:01:12Z
Priya: This dropped our available GPUs by ~18% — some customer jobs started queuing, cost on preemptible fallback spiked.
Jamal: Any sign of secure-boot toggles or UEFI flags flipping during the flash?
Alex: Quick grep of the flash run shows a 1-line firmware installer error on 3 hosts followed by an IPMI reset. No explicit secureboot toggle in the installer logs.
Alex: Pasting the OOB trace for one host:
```
[2024-11-05T22:00:59Z] BMC: fw update v1.3.7 -> v1.3.8
[2024-11-05T22:01:10Z] OOB: serial-mux heartbeat lost
[2024-11-05T22:01:12Z] Kernel: pci: GPU reset triggered
[2024-11-05T22:01:15Z] Scheduler: evict pod xyz
```
Morgan: Hmm. Could be the new BMC image toggling watchdog timers -> TTL squelch. Any quick workaround?
Jamal: We should avoid full rollback unless necessary. Can we toggle BMC heartbeat watchdog back to prior window via oobctl?
Alex: Quick mitigation I pushed to runbook: run on affected rack
```
# re-open oob serial mux and nudge watchdog
oobctl set-watchdog --host @pool-gpu-highmem-3 --window 60000
oobctl restart-service bmc-serialmux --host @pool-gpu-highmem-3
```
Priya: Applying that now to two nodes to test. Monitoring jobs.
infra-bot: [RUNBOOK] runbook: https://redwood/infrarunbooks/oob-ttl-squelch
Morgan: If watchdog change stabilizes, we can batch remainder. If not, plan = rollback to v1.3.7 and schedule a canary on 2 nodes.
Jamal: Also validate NVRAM/per-host UEFI flags: `ipmitool nvram list` — suspicious drift can flip secure-boot state.
Alex: Good call. I grabbed nvram dump on one host and there's a mismatch in boot-order meta; not a secure-boot flag flip but could interact with BMC re-init causing serial mux tear-down.
Priya: Cost note — while GPUs are down, autoscaler pulled spot instances; FYI billing ops flagged a short-term 6% cost bump.
Morgan: After we stabilize, let's add a preflight check in the release job: verify OOB heartbeat + nvram checksum before promoting.
Alex: Agreed. For now rolling mitigation to remaining 4 nodes. If anyone sees finish/fail call out in thread.
Priya: +1 monitoring shows two nodes recovered after watchdog nudge, others pending. :eyes:
Jamal: I'll prepare rollback patch (v1.3.7 image + signature) in case.
Alex: Thanks — will follow up with postmortem if rollback is needed.
